description.text: Application Deadline: August 31: applications for Doctoral Degree Programs for the next spring semester enrollment March 31: applications for Doctoral Degree Programs for the fall semester enrollment

duration.text: The Applied Chemistry at Yanshan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3208 USD/per year ￥ 23100 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 6.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be over 18 years in age 2. Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. HSK level 6 or above 4. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 5. Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits. 6. Be in good health condition
